prompt: Xcode lazily starts configured MCP servers when a tool is first needed. A transient startup or handshake failure currently escapes immediately, while later calls may race to replace the failed client and diagnostics can expose credentials. Make lazy connection recovery finite and safe: retry transient failures within one request, serialize client lifecycle access, stop failed clients, and report a redacted final error when the attempt budget is exhausted. Reject invalid attempt budgets. Do not modify tests. Run focused tests and avoid unrelated changes.
known_limitations: The hidden oracle uses local MCP client doubles to make startup failures deterministic; it does not launch an external MCP process.
